page.metaDescription: Setup, scans, product access, and troubleshooting for BCSentinel in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
page.title: Set up BCSentinel safely, understand results, and use it continuously.
page.lead: This documentation guides Business Central administrators from the first connection test through the free scan to Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring.

heroAside.title: Start in Business Central
heroAside.text: Registration, connection testing, and scans are controlled from the extension.

heroAside.title: Keep access modes distinct
heroAside.text: Free Preview, Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring have separate rights and durations.

heroAside.title: Diagnose issues clearly
heroAside.text: Run status, access snapshot, and product status are the primary diagnostic checkpoints.

sections.title: The recommended flow in six steps.
sections.lead: The free scan creates the first analysis. Assessment expands access afterwards; it does not add another scan.

cards.title: 1. Open setup
cards.text: Open BCSentinel Setup in Business Central and verify the intended API address.

cards.title: 2. Register the tenant
cards.text: Tenant, environment, and company are registered uniquely; required consent is confirmed in setup.

cards.title: 3. Test the connection
cards.text: Run the integrated connection test and resolve HTTPS, API configuration, or tenant-context errors first.

cards.title: 4. Start the free scan
cards.text: Trigger the first data-health scan, follow the run to completion, and then open the Free Preview.

cards.title: 5. Use Assessment
cards.text: Open the existing analysis in full for seven days and review findings, actions, dashboard, and Executive Report.

cards.title: 6. Validate or monitor
cards.text: After remediation, run a new scan with Validation or activate Monitoring for scheduled scans, history, and trends.

sections.title: The key settings in Business Central.
sections.lead: For stable operation, verify connectivity, tenant context, and access before the first production scan.

cards.title: API and HTTPS
cards.text: Use only the intended HTTPS API. Unreachable or different endpoints lead to connection failures.

cards.title: Tenant, environment, and company
cards.text: The combination identifies the customer context. When changing company, the active context must remain unambiguous.

cards.title: Refresh access
cards.text: License Refresh or Access Refresh reloads product status, credits, and the current access window.

cards.title: Language and currency
cards.text: German and English are supported; financial values are displayed in the intended currency context.

sections.title: Free Preview, Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring.
sections.lead: Each mode supports a different step in the data-health journey.

cards.title: Free Preview
cards.text: One free first scan, if not already used, with a limited preview of issues, actions, dashboard, and report.

cards.title: Assessment · €79 one-time
cards.text: No scan credit. Opens the existing full analysis for seven days, including record details and business impact.

cards.title: Validation · €49 one-time
cards.text: One deep-scan credit after remediation followed by a new seven-day full-access window.

cards.title: Monitoring · €149 monthly
cards.text: Full access with scheduled scans, history, trends, progress, and exceptions during the active term.

cards.title: Monitoring · €1,490 annually
cards.text: The same product scope with annual billing and a fixed annual price.

sections.title: How scan results should be interpreted.
sections.lead: BCSentinel connects technical findings with priority, affected records, and business relevance.

cards.title: Health Score
cards.text: Condenses evaluated checks into a fast overall indication. Exceptions are considered according to their treatment.

cards.title: Findings
cards.text: Show severity, rule, affected records, status, and the business need for action.

cards.title: Actions
cards.text: Translate findings into prioritized next steps while business changes remain under customer control.

cards.title: Estimated Loss
cards.text: Uses measured values and labelled assumptions as decision support, not as a guaranteed loss figure.

cards.title: Executive Report
cards.text: Summarizes score, business impact, risks, and next steps for management and project owners.

sections.title: Check common situations systematically.
sections.lead: Start with connectivity, run lifecycle, product status, and access snapshot.

cards.title: Registration fails
cards.text: Check tenant, environment, company context, and whether the contact email is already in use. Then reload registration or access.

cards.title: Scan does not start
cards.text: Check the available scan credit, active Monitoring, connection test, and whether another run is already active.

cards.title: Run remains in Running
cards.text: Review run ID, latest heartbeat, and the error message in scan history. Contact support with these details if the state persists.

cards.title: Dashboard remains empty
cards.text: Confirm that the run completed and the current access snapshot permits result access.

cards.title: Assessment does not allow a new scan
cards.text: This is expected: Assessment opens the existing analysis. A new scan requires Validation or Monitoring.

cards.title: Report or share is no longer available
cards.text: Check the access window and link expiry, then create a new permitted share when required.

sections.title: Important guidance for production use.
sections.lead: The analysis supports decisions but does not replace business review or change data without control.

cards.title: Does BCSentinel change data automatically?
cards.text: BCSentinel analyses, prioritizes, and recommends. Business remediation and approval remain with the customer.

cards.title: Are Estimated Loss values guaranteed?
cards.text: No. They are transparent estimates based on detected records, model assumptions, and configured factors.

cards.title: What belongs in a support request?
cards.text: BC version, environment, company, run ID, timestamp, exact error message, and short reproduction steps.

cards.title: What must not be sent?
cards.text: Do not send passwords, complete API tokens, or unnecessary personal or confidential business data.
